nodes.label: Append-Only Checkpoint Writes
nodes.rationale: Delegated workers replacing the shared log truncated history; append atomically and verify prior line count after each handoff. Per-observation files avoid the collision class.

nodes.label: Sibling Consumer Enumeration
nodes.rationale: Fixing the named implementation does not close sibling consumers; inventory every production entry point and test durable invariants under partial persistence failure. In-memory rollback is insufficient when a write can corrupt durable state.

nodes.label: Shared Shutdown Coordinator
nodes.rationale: Separate IPC and bootstrap shutdown paths could double-close sessions; route through one attempt-deduplicated coordinator with explicit approved/confirmed/prevented/aborted outcomes; retain confirmed success for idempotence.

nodes.label: Generation-Bound Quit Ownership
nodes.rationale: One layer owns quit initiation; each attempt carries a generation token so deferred callbacks from stale attempts cannot mutate newer retries.

nodes.label: Bounded Bootstrap Termination
nodes.rationale: Logging a rejected cleanup promise is not lifecycle completion; one bounded retry then nonzero app.exit avoids headless process with live services.

nodes.label: Idempotent Conflict-Bound Replay
nodes.rationale: Replay of qualification evidence raised raw SQLite UNIQUE failures; identical replay must be idempotent and conflicting evidence preserved; no synthetic bootstrap row added since no trusted source exists.

nodes.label: Digest-Keyed Data URL Import
nodes.rationale: Replaced filesystem staging with exact-byte self-contained ESM imports keyed by digest, rejecting dependencies.

nodes.label: Parent-Chain Identity Validation
nodes.rationale: Validate every directory component from compositionRoot to module parent, reject symlinks, compare device/inode after descriptor reads.

nodes.label: Post-Open Snapshot Identity Check
nodes.rationale: Authoritative snapshot must re-check pathname and parent identity after open to defeat swap races.
